article.title: MerchantFloor把商品圖與文案生成接入Shopify上架流程
article.title_en: MerchantFloor connects product image and copy generation to Shopify listings
article.summary: 商戶可上載商品照片和資料，先審閱生成結果，再送往Shopify管理介面。
article.summary_en: Merchants upload a photo and notes, review the results and send them to Shopify admin.
highlights: 工具可生成商品圖片、描述及搜尋欄位。
公司說明列明免費方案圖片附有浮水印。
highlights_en: The tool generates product images, descriptions and search metadata.
The company says free-tier images carry a watermark.
article.why: 小型電商可集中處理圖片與文案，仍可在匯入前核對商品細節。
article.why_en: Small stores can prepare images and copy together and check product facts before handoff.
article.next_step: 先挑一款外觀容易核對的商品，檢查圖片、尺寸、材質及替代文字。
article.next_step_en: Start with one item and check images, dimensions, materials and alt text.
article.detail: MerchantFloor把商品素材生成與上架交接連在一起。公告列出的輸出包括白底圖、生活場景圖、商品描述和圖片替代文字。商戶先確認和修改內容，再送到管理介面。對珠寶或具特定顏色的產品，可逐項比對原圖，尤其留意部件、材質及顏色有沒有被生成工具改動。
article.detail_en: MerchantFloor links asset generation to the listing handoff. Outputs include white-background and lifestyle images, descriptions and alt text. Merchants review and edit before sending them to Shopify. Check components, materials and colours against original photos, particularly for jewellery or colour-sensitive products.
